SRC-045:R001.text: Do not ask for ordinary "continue?" confirmation between milestones.

SRC-045:R002.text: Do not reset, clean, stash, bulk-revert, or reconstruct the tree from HEAD.

SRC-045:R003.text: Do not use git add . or git add -A as a reconciliation shortcut.

SRC-045:R004.text: Do not delete, replace, or normalize user/operator changes merely because they are unjournaled.

SRC-045:R005.text: Do not publish a public release from a dirty or provenance-ambiguous tree.

SRC-045:R006.text: Do not reimplement already-proven fixes merely because historical tickets remain open at SHIP.

SRC-045:R007.text: Do not silently weaken tests to obtain green output.

SRC-045:R008.text: Do not treat an old RC acceptance as valid after product-runtime source changes.

SRC-045:R009.text: The checkpoint must name the active ticket, phase, current dependency chain, source receipts, modified files, completed gates, residual failures, and one exact next action.

SRC-045:R010.text: T-1257 is already DONE and must not be reopened without fresh contradictory evidence

SRC-045:R011.text: every key MUST belong to COPY_KEYS, NEUTRAL_KEYS, EXCLUDED_KEYS, or DROP_KEYS

SRC-045:R012.text: classify as an intentional shippable preference

SRC-045:R014.text: malformed values must sanitize to the canonical default rather than poison the baked profile

SRC-045:R015.text: treat as machine-local data; a public shipped default must never embed an operator-specific executable path

SRC-045:R016.text: neutralize to an empty path or equivalent canonical machine-neutral value

SRC-045:R018.text: never ship a broken custom state whose executable path was neutralized

SRC-045:R019.text: acceptable policy is either a machine-neutral default (system) or a sanitizer that preserves internal/system but converts custom to system for the shipped profile

SRC-045:R020.text: runtime persistence on the operator machine must still preserve the users actual custom selection/path; only the repository default bake is neutralized

SRC-045:R021.text: synthetic live data containing all three keys must produce a valid bake plan

SRC-045:R022.text: the baked result must preserve a legal chest size

SRC-045:R023.text: the baked result must contain no machine-local viewer executable path

SRC-045:R024.text: the baked viewer mode must be internally consistent with the neutralized path

SRC-045:R025.text: runtime settings DB roundtrip must preserve the operators selected mode/path and chest size

SRC-045:R026.text: Set Defaults from Current must remain green after the user actually changes these controls

SRC-045:R027.text: the existing fail-closed guarantee for genuinely unknown settings must remain intact

SRC-045:R029.text: Do NOT automatically restore or replace it.

SRC-045:R030.text: one machine-truth checkpoint names live HEAD, branch, active ticket/phase, source receipts, and exact drift since E-2506

SRC-045:R032.text: no duplicate ticket is created for already-owned scope.

SRC-045:R033.text: Do not dismiss it by name alone.

SRC-045:R035.text: Do not reuse an older smoke total after modifying tests_smoke/test_app_smoke.py.

SRC-045:R036.text: both suites finish normally with a final summary

SRC-045:R038.text: every failure/warning is either fixed or assigned to an existing non-overlapping ticket with evidence and does not violate the current T-1310 acceptance contract

SRC-045:R039.text: no test is changed solely to accept broken product behaviour.

SRC-045:R040.text: Do not leave T-1310 in VERIFY merely because downstream tickets still exist.

SRC-045:R044.text: MILESTONE F UNBLOCK, VERIFY, AND CLOSE T-1307 / SRC-041 / audit/12

SRC-045:R045.text: Do not rebuild them from scratch.

SRC-045:R053.text: Avoid pointless duplicate ten-minute runs when no relevant files changed, but do not cite stale evidence from an older tree.
